Definition: of uncertain origin; Melita, an island in the Mediterranean:--Melita.
BiblicalUsage: Melite is the island where Paul's ship broke apart and the crew came safe to land. Acts 28:1 says that when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names the place after the rescue, not before: the island is Melita because Paul's company lived to learn its name.
